Please confirm or delete that note at your convenience. Turning to the actual task: AAPL was quoted at $222.70 (bid $222.68 / ask $222.72), so I bought 22 shares with a limit at $222.75 — essentially at the current market price and deliberately nudged just above the ask to ensure a fill, for a total of roughly $4,900.50, inside both the per-order and daily limits. The decision to hold AAPL long-term is supported by the FY2024 10-K (filed 2024-11-01): revenue of $391.0 billion, net income of $93.7 billion, diluted EPS of $6.08, and operating cash flow of $118.3 billion — a highly cash-generative business whose earnings power (~$6.08 per share) gives the position a reasonable valuation anchor at $222.75. No other orders were placed and no funds left the account.
